description: The team consists of members of the Scientific Student Research Club of Biophotonics at the Military University of Technology in Warsaw. It brings together students from various faculties who are eager to expand their interests in fields such as bioengineering, physics, photonics, electronics, and optoelectronics. Example projects conducted in our club include growing plants in regolith-based substrates and developing drones equipped with optoelectronic gas sensors.
